note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = hand pivot. Plan sizes from the trace of Bulova's official front render (43 mm case width = the bezel rim flat to flat, official; lug width 22.1 mm in the render against the official 22 mm; lug tip to lug tip 49.1 mm in the render against the official 50 mm case length). Heights are a front-relief reading of the official 12.1 mm. The wave dial, minute track, prints, date window and the bezel insert's print are the dial map; the strap is the strap map.

strap.note: House curl (SUR419P1): 7 mm radius from the lug tips, end_y = tip + 2.2 R; taper read from the render past the tips

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers render transmission from a low-resolution buffer and blur the dial

steel_brushed.note: ambientCG Metal009 (CC0) NormalGL at 1K; bevels keep the plain polished material

review.subtitle: Bulova Marine Star Precisionist 43 mm, yellow wave dial, black twelve-sided bezel, black rubber strap. Front relief GLB, round 1.
specs: lug tip to lug tip in the render (50 official)
notes: Built from Bulova's official straight-on render; the supplied photo is the same view and is kept as a second reference.

Modelled: brushed steel case and lugs, twelve-sided bezel with a polished rim, applied steel indices with lume and the applied logo, polished hands with lume, open windows and flat tails, seconds hand with the red-framed lume triangle, fluted crown, rubber strap with the house curl.
From the photo maps: yellow wave dial, minute track, BULOVA / Marine Star / 200m / 262 kHz, the date window (18), the bezel insert's numerals and markers, and the strap's wave pattern.
The render's lugs measure 49.1 mm tip to tip against the official 50 mm case length; the render was followed. Heights are estimated from the official 12.1 mm.
